answer: Each agent bonds stake, proves Semaphore membership, and commits to an epoch polynomial whose evaluations enforce RLN rate limits. A zero-knowledge message proof binds to a nullifier; reusing it with a distinct message exposes two Shamir shares, allowing interpolation of the secret-bearing polynomial and recovery of the private key. The verifier checks the evidence and instantly slashes collateral. Cipher, delta, and relic are transcript labels, not trust assumptions.
